metadata.description: Agentic AI — three plugins for Claude Code: persistent memory (Cortex, ported to TS), genius reasoning (zetetic team), and PRD generation. They share one install / one update path. Codebase intelligence ships separately as the canonical Rust plugin automatised-pipeline@automatised-pipeline-marketplace.

plugins.name: memory
plugins.description: Persistent memory for Claude Code — TS port of Cortex. Thermodynamic heat/decay, intent-aware retrieval, biological plasticity, codebase intelligence integration. SQLite by default; PostgreSQL + pgvector when DATABASE_URL is set. 41 published papers as sources. 0.3.2: fix invalid manifest — inline mcpServers object (was a stale string path to a non-existent ../.mcp.json, which made `claude plugin install memory@agentic-ai` fail).

plugins.name: reasoning
plugins.description: 97 genius reasoning patterns from history's greatest minds + 19 team specialist agents under one zetetic epistemic standard. 61 skills, 25 commands, 16 lifecycle hooks.

plugins.name: prd
plugins.description: Stateless reducer that turns a feature description into a 9-file PRD. Multi-judge verification with weighted-average + Bayesian consensus, calibrated against externally-grounded oracles (schema/math/code/spec). Phase 4 closed loop: per-judge Bayesian reliability calibration, Kaplan-Meier retry budgets, Clopper-Pearson KPI gates.
